I am going to Lichfield from Monday to Saturday of next week - to talk and look over letters of [our noble martyr](/person/1155) with the [Selwyns](/person/1295). I believe I am to manage the putting his [life](/book/102) together but it will be more editing than writing. I seem to have thought of nothing but the wonderful symbolism of the work of those unconscious savages.[^1]
Your affectionate

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY refers to the murder of the Rt. Rev. John Coleridge Patteson in the Santa Cruz Islands. It was reported that Patteson’s body had received five wounds, as Christ\'s had.
